response.overview: Parrucchiere di provincia (Provincial Hairdresser) is a 2002 Italian adult feature directed by Steve Morelli. Set in a quiet, small-town hair salon, the film revolves around a local stylist whose everyday grooming and beauty services frequently escalate into uninhibited, passionate encounters with an eager clientele. Blending light situational comedy with highly charged erotic vignettes, the movie showcases the classic aesthetic and character-driven focus typical of early 2000s European adult cinema.
